messages:
Sara: Morning team, quick async standup for sales — pipeline + blockers.

Sara: Snapshot: NovaHealth (on-prem + SOC2 ask, latency SLA), Gridlytics (pricing push), Parkside (legal redlines on DPA). Blockers: NovaHealth wants trial cluster, Gridlytics requested steep discount, Parkside awaiting counsel.

Mike: Updated demo deck with VPC flow & perf slides. Need infra to confirm Dedicated p99 numbers. Also noticed a model config perf blip yesterday; not blocking the demo but will track.

Jules: I can pull SOC2 artifacts and a short security summary. Link placeholder: https://redwood.internal/security/soc2-summary

Jules: Dedicated p99 looks achievable (<200ms) at their expected QPS per infra prelim. Will formalize a statement by EOD. Also check NovaHealth data residency (EU vs US).

Rahul: Gridlytics asked for 25% off on 12mo. Pricing policy cap is 20% with finance signoff. Proposal: counter with 10% + 3mo onboarding credit. Posting in #sales-pricing for quick approval.

Priya: Parkside legal sent redlines on DPA yesterday; waiting on their counsel. If no reply by EOD tomorrow I'll escalate. NovaHealth asked about a 2-week dedicated trial cluster 1; need infra availability check.

SecurityBot: compliance artifacts updated (2026-03-16 18:42 UTC). SOC2 v3 available at /compliance/soc2_v3.pdf 512 tagging @Jules

Mike: Thanks — pulling SOC2. @Sara for the demo can you confirm their three KPIs? I'm assuming latency, throughput and failover behavior.

Sara: Correct: latency (p50/p99), stability under load, and failover behavior. I'll post a 1-page demo brief & script in #sales-docs in ~20m.

Jules: Quick legal/security q: do we have an approved co-deployment NDA template they can sign? If not I'll coordinate with legal. @Priya

Priya: NDA-standard-v4 exists in drive. Will paste link once I have it here. :white_check_mark:

Rahul: Procurement note: NovaHealth asks PO net 90. Finance prefers net 30 for new enterprise deals. This might require escalation to Emma if they push.

Sara: Good catch. I'll prep an escalation note for Emma only if they refuse net 30. Demo invite goes out in ~15m unless anyone objects.

Mike: :thumbsup: I'll run the failover steps and bring the debug logs for the demo.

Priya: Dropping DPA link: https://drive.redwood/docs/DPA-NovaHealth-v1.pdf

Jules: Got it. I'll draft an SOC2 excerpt they can include with the contract; expect by EOD.

Rahul: I'll post the Gridlytics counter in #sales-pricing for signoff now.

Sara: Thanks all. If anything urgent, DM me. /end
